A_spectroscopic.note: photon e^{y/2}/2000 + per-line scatter (window); outer elements photon only (no gas model): window numbers only are meaningful

B_primary.note: A + measured ACE scatter per element with Gaussian correlation l = 0.14 um (fitted to 0.61/0.14)

B2_primary_separated_noise.note: B with detector noise e^y/S_det + floor 1/2000 + shared reference

C_disc_independent.note: B with the discrepancy term independent between elements

D_disc_exp_0p10.note: B with exponential correlation l = 0.10 um

E_disc_exp_0p25.note: B with exponential correlation l = 0.25 um

F_disc_exp_0p20.note: B with exponential correlation l = 0.20 um (the 1/e length of the measured profile)

G_disc_adopted_level.note: B with the discrepancy term at the 2.47e-3-anchored level (x1.33)

H_disc_adopted_indep.note: adopted floors, independent, with the gas state and photon term (round-70 'paper floors as covariance')

I_detector_only_no_floor.note: B without the 1/2000 systematic floor (detector noise and reference only)

B_plus_gray_offset.note: primary model with a constant slant-OD offset common to all MIR elements as a 48th parameter (flat prior)

units: Tg (mass of the prescribed silica profile)
audit.prior_note: gas nodes: Gaussian prior with 6-km correlation length; aerosol parameters: 1e3 in their own units (nominal 60/1500 nm radii, widths 1.6/1.8), i.e. unconstrained; silica 1e3 Tg
audit.jacobian_units: MIR rows: slant OD per unit of the state parameter; triplet rows: m^-1 per unit

response_derivatives.formula: dy_i/dp = <dtau/dp>_T - int[d(w S)/dp T]/A + int[d(w S)/dp]/B, A = int w S T, B = int w S; for the registration and the edge softness the first term vanishes and the two response terms are evaluated with dw/dp analytic
response_derivatives.atmospheric_term_for_response_parameters: zero (the response parameters do not enter tau)

continuity_880.note: y_i is continuous in the registration for either response (a shifted integral of a bounded integrand); the step edge only makes the derivative rougher

coherent_o3_2pct.note: a coherent +2 % error on every O3 line, carried through the nonlinear element observable at every tangent (14-60 km, 0.5-km steps) and peeled with the exact path matrix; f alpha_O3 is 0.02 times the mean-cross-section local O3 extinction of the element

exponential_scan_ratios.note: the paper's '+7 to +23 %' mixed the fine-grid correlated values with the design-grid baselines; on the common fine grid the ratios are those listed
